summary_en: NITCHITSU acquired 15,000 shares at JPY 2,473 per share (JPY 37.095 million total) on November 16, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, representing 0.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The purchase supports flexible capital policy and employee incentive programs through restricted stock grants.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, NITCHITSU's board of directors authorized the acquisition of its own shares under the Companies Act, with execution completed on November 16, 2026. The company purchased 15,000 shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading at a fixed price of JPY 2,473 per share, resulting in a total acquisition cost of JPY 37.095 million. This represents 0.7% of the outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated against the 2.118 million shares outstanding as of October 31, 2026.

The purchase was executed as a block transaction on November 16 at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time with a single trading order specific to that time window. The company stated two purposes for the acquisition: to implement flexible capital policy in response to changing business environments, and to secure shares for its employee incentive program, specifically restricted stock grants distributed through the company's employee share ownership plan. The authorization represents opportunistic deployment of capital rather than a new or expanded repurchase program.
